chapter: New York with Lester Young and Coleman Hawkins
title: How bebop got its name
summary: Thompson says writers named bebop or rebop after a drum and horn ending, and did not know how to name the music.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: It was during the time that the writers were beginning to categorize music and musicians, you know, as to what they were playing. And they very often referred to the music as bebop or rebop. And would you believe it, ironically it came because the last note they played, that the drums and the horns played rebop, on maybe one or two songs. So they said rebop, you know.

But it wasn't that at all, it was just the guys were playing music and they had different endings -- you know, people that would write about music and don't always know how to name it. They only know how to describe it, which is understandable. You know.
